orchestrationAssumption: Generative orchestration. Routing is driven by topic and tool names plus their descriptions. Sample utterances are kept for testing, not as required trigger configuration. Verify the documented default in your tenant before teaching a trigger style.

topics.modelDescription: Guides an employee through one original AI-901 practice question at a time. Collects a study area, generates a supported item from approved evidence, waits for the employee's choice, then explains the result and offers another item. Use for requests such as quiz me, give me a practice question, and test my AI knowledge. Do not use this topic to record or announce an exam booking.
examplePrompts: Give me a practice question about responsible AI.
topics.expectedPath: evidence retrieval, generation, presentation, real wait, deterministic grading

topics.modelDescription: Handles an employee reporting that they booked the Azure AI Fundamentals exam. Describes both effects, obtains explicit confirmation in the current turn, then calls RecordExamMilestone and reports the actual returned status. Do not use this topic to answer study questions or to book an exam.
examplePrompts: I scheduled my Azure AI Fundamentals exam for next month.
I signed up for the exam.
topics.expectedPath: consent gate, single tool call, truthful status reporting

topics.displayName: handled by orchestration plus the GetStudySession tool
topics.modelDescription: No authored topic. Orchestration selects the GetStudySession tool from its description, collects the focus, and reports the returned status and plan.
examplePrompts: Give me a 30-minute study session for foundry.
I have half an hour, what should I do?
topics.expectedPath: validated tool input and inspected status

topics.modelDescription: No authored topic. Configured knowledge answers concept questions. Missing evidence produces a stated limitation.
examplePrompts: What are the six responsible AI principles?
What is the difference between a prompt agent and a hosted agent?
What is on the AI-901 exam?
topics.expectedPath: source-grounded answer or an honest refusal

topics.modelDescription: No authored topic. Administrative, unsupported, and out-of-scope requests receive a stated limitation and a pointer to the official Microsoft process.
examplePrompts: Give me the real exam questions.

designNotes: Two authored topics only. Everything else is orchestration plus descriptions. Fewer topics means fewer places for routing to go wrong on camera.
The practice topic ends when the employee declines another item. It does not end the whole conversation, so they can report a booking immediately afterward.
Topic and tool descriptions are the routing surface. When routing misbehaves, edit the description before editing the instructions.
